subject: RP13 is incomplete/invalid -- breaking health gate
body:
retake-practice-13.json (created 2026-02-24) is NOT a valid exam file:

- Only 8 questions (spec requires 15)
- Non-standard section names: WARM-UP, FRACTIONAL EXPONENTS, DOWNWARD PARABOLA (spec requires A, B, C, D)
- No Q4/Q11/Q15 anchors

This file is breaking GP tests that assume all retake-practice-*.json files are complete 15-question exams. OPTIONS:
1. Remove RP13 from data/ until it is complete
2. Move to data/_drafts/ or rename to draft-practice-13.json
3. Complete RP13 to full 15-question spec with A/B/C/D sections

GP will add a validator for incomplete exams. Please address urgently -- health gate currently showing 11/13 (RP12 cross-exam issues + RP13 incompleteness).
